note: Antigua and Barbuda: nationals of Dominica, Grenada, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines move freely; nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 180 days or 30. Everyone else needs an Electronic Entry Visa, applied for online. A 30-day visa on arrival for holders of a Schengen, Canadian, UK or US visa or residence isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
